author: Komp
body:
Hey I know it's just a kick so it's not a huge deal but it'd be nice to get it off of my profile. https://avicus.net/punishments/646249

I made the mistake of swearing as our team got rushed – I hadn't played on Avicus for a while so I didn't really remember the rules. It won't happen again.

title: Appealing a kick

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey Komp!
I'm afraid we don't appeal kicks if they are valid.
Please be aware that kicks if you ever apply for staff or any avicus rank only really apply for a short period of time and therefore you shouldn't worry too much about it.
I'm glad to hear it won't happen again , and if that is the case you have nothing to worry about!

Appeal Denied
If you are happy with the verdict and answer of this appeal please say so and i will lock the post.
